hero.body: Experience the divine with India’s most trusted pilgrimage travel partner. We ensure every yatra is safe, comfortable, and spiritually fulfilling.

primary.title: Char Dham Packages
primary.body: Complete Char Dham yatra — Kedarnath, Badrinath, Gangotri & Yamunotri. Guided, comfortable, and spiritually complete.

cards.title: Helicopter Packages
cards.body: Reach sacred shrines swiftly and comfortably by helicopter.

cards.title: All Temple Packages
cards.body: Explore sacred temples across India — curated pilgrimage tours.

whyUs.heading: Journey With Confidence
whyUs.body: We’ve been guiding pilgrims on their most sacred journeys for over a decade. Every detail — from accommodation to transportation — is handled with care so you can focus entirely on your spiritual experience.

features.title: Safety First
features.body: Experienced guides, vetted vehicles, and 24/7 support throughout your yatra.

features.title: Comfortable Stays
features.body: Carefully selected hotels and dharamshalas at every stop along the route.

features.title: Expert Guides
features.body: Knowledgeable local guides who understand the spiritual significance of each shrine.

features.title: Hassle-Free Booking
features.body: One call or message is all it takes. We handle permits, bookings, and logistics.
